title: multi-sdk-credential-matrix-and-stream-ergonomics-version-sync
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: multiple customers reported subtle token race and opaque retry behavior when consumers switch credential providers during long-lived streaming sessions. This PR implements a coordinated, opt-in credential matrix and a small ergonomic surface for streamed async iterables across Python/TypeScript/Go so that apps can safely rotate credentials and tune retry windows with fewer surprises. Changeset overview: 1) Introduce Credential Matrix abstraction (credential profiles + failover order + prefetch hints) and feature-gate it behind SDK runtime flags to allow staged rollout; 2) Add a lightweight Retry Profile DSL and default presets tuned for streaming (fast-reconnect, conservative-kv-cache, transient-only); 3) Harmonize stream consumer ergonomics: typed async iterator helpers in TS, an AsyncStreamAdapter in Python with simpler .resume() semantics, and a StreamHandle in Go with ClearLease method; 4) Small API surface tweaks for discoverability (rename auth.Context -> auth.SessionContext in SDKs; add deprecation notes and compatibility helpers); 5) Version bumps: python-sdk v1.19.0, typescript-sdk v2.8.0, go-sdk v1.5.0; 6) Docs/upgrade guide and canary rollout checklist. Rollout plan: merged to main gated by an opt-in feature flag; CI and internal canary for 72h; then flip default after telemetry shows no regressions. Testing: unit tests across three SDKs, integration smoke with Hosted API, and a manual canary run against dedicated customer staging environment. Related: ENG-8421 for telemetry, ENG-9012 for customer report. Notes: No breaking runtime surface for common patterns; calling code that relied on the old auth.Context name will see a deprecation warning but compatibility shim is provided. This description is a single-line blob for PR export and contains the checklist and contexts.

release_notes: Feature: Credential Matrix (opt-in) across Python/TS/Go; Feature: streaming ergonomics improvements (py AsyncStreamAdapter, ts typed async iterator helpers, go StreamHandle.ClearLease); Feature: Retry Profile DSL with streaming presets; Chore: SDK version bumps py@1.19.0 ts@2.8.0 go@1.5.0; Docs: upgrade guide and canary checklist; Note: auth.Context renamed to auth.SessionContext with a compatibility shim for one release.
merge_summary: Merged after two approving reviews and green CI. Canary run scheduled post-merge and feature gated behind runtime flags. No immediate rollback needed.
notes_for_support: If customers report unexpected resume failures, ask them to enable verbose sdk logs (SDK_SAMPLING=debug) and check credential matrix ordering. Provide migration snippet included in docs/guides/sdk-multi-cred-upgrade.md.
